# Provider fixtures

This directory contains Claude usage fixtures sanitized from real responses. Their strings, numbers, dates, names, balances, and reset values are deterministic synthetic values. The current-schema fixture also retains only the authorized public-safe window shape, numeric range class, and timestamp parse classification.

The current recorded status is Claude `available` and Codex `unavailable`. The Codex fixture remains unavailable because its single authorized capture attempt failed without producing a response fixture. The machine-checked status is in `../evidence/provider-fixtures.json`. Fixture-dependent compatibility checks skip when the corresponding fixture is unavailable; this status does not certify compatibility. Real-response evidence is useful for checking provider response shapes, but an unavailable fixture is disclosure only, not a release condition. Release notes should identify providers that have not been checked against a real response. A maintainer may add a sanitized-real fixture later when convenient; no second-person approval is required.
